name: Hinkelsteinwiese
beschreibung: The campsite Hinkelsteinwiese is located in the Tiroler Unterland at the foot of the Kitzbüheler Alpen. The facility is situated in a clearing and is surrounded by mountain pines and alpine meadows. Its location away from the main road creates a quiet atmosphere. Several marked hiking trails and routes for mountain bikers run nearby. In winter, the Skigebiet Wilder Kaiser-Brixental can be reached in about ten minutes by car. The site offers pitches for motorhomes and tents with electricity connection. A sanitary building with showers, WCs and a laundry room is available. The reception sells rolls and regional products.
